info.title: Dropsite API
info.description: Publish static sites. Every endpoint except GET /openapi.json and POST /connect/exchange requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Times are RFC 3339 in UTC. IDs are strings. Resources of other users and admin endpoints for non-admins answer 404. A request with `X-Dropsite-Assistant: mcp` (made for an AI assistant) gets the rights of the MCP endpoint: no administrator powers except the root domain.

get.summary: This document

post.summary: Exchange a one-time connect code from the web interface for a new API token (no bearer token needed)

post.description: The body may be at most max_site_bytes + max_files KiB + 1 MiB (plus multipart framing); larger bodies get 413 without being read fully. The source is `cli` when X-Dropsite-Client starts with `cli/`, otherwise `api`. At most 30 publications per user per hour.

post.summary: Add a channel. Telegram without target returns a binding link; telegram with a chat ID and email send a confirmation code; webhook returns its signing secret once

patch.description: Setting enabled to true also resumes a channel paused by the circuit breaker (paused_at is cleared). Turning a channel off cancels its queued deliveries.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Endpoint name: 1-40 characters a-z, 0-9 and hyphens

put.summary: Create an endpoint or replace its configuration
put.description: Pages of the site call https://<site>/_dropsite/proxy/<name>/<path>; the request goes to upstream_url + /<path> with the stored key added. The key is pasted only in the web interface (secret_url): a body with a `secret` field is refused with `proxy_secret_ui_only`. Changing upstream_url, allowed_hosts, auth or auth_name removes a stored key; methods, paths and enabled keep it. Omitted optional fields get their defaults.

delete.summary: Delete an endpoint together with its key

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Only paths starting with this

patch.summary: Add or replace files (at most 1 MB of content), delete files or folders and download assets on top of base_deploy_id; publishes a new release (source mcp). A stale base answers 409 deploy_conflict

post.summary: Read files of a release: text as is, small binary files in base64, at most 256 KB of content per call
Open an upload session (at most 3 per user, closed after 30 idle minutes)
Add files (at most 1 MB of content per call) or downloads to an own session; other users' sessions answer upload_expired
Publish an upload session as a new release and close it

bearer.description: API token issued in the web interface or by POST /tokens

Invalid.description: Invalid input or archive validation failed (codes invalid_input, slug_*, title_invalid, domain_*, archive_*, ...)

NotFound.description: Not found, including resources of other users and admin endpoints for non-admins

TooLarge.description: Upload or unpacked archive too large (archive_too_large, archive_file_too_large, archive_too_many_files)

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07 or 2020-12) of the documents, or null

public_url.description: https://<site address>/_dropsite/data/<name>; empty while the site has no active address

schema.description: null removes the schema (not allowed for moderated collections)

id.description: assigned by the server when omitted; an existing ID is replaced

data.description: at most 16 KB in compact form

position.description: sort position; omitted keeps the stored one (0 for new documents)

replace.description: remove every document of the collection first

max_domains_per_site.description: Own domains one site may have

max_inline_bytes.description: Largest file content of one files or uploads call

root_site.description: Administrators only: the site on the root domain; null otherwise

Hostname.description: An address of a site. Only active addresses serve the site; external domains are pending until an administrator approves them.

reason.description: Why an administrator rejected the domain

Domain.description: An external domain with its site and owner (admin endpoints).

expected.description: SERVER_IPS, or the addresses of the base domain and API host

preview_url.description: Address serving exactly this release (TLS_MODE=wildcard and status ready only), with X-Robots-Tag: noindex; null otherwise

url.description: Primary address: slug if set, otherwise the random default

value.description: Full token value, shown only once

code.description: Connect code such as ABCD-EFGH-JKMNP; case, spaces and dashes are ignored

name.description: Name of the new token (default: Connected <date>)

value.description: Full token value, shown only once

limits.description: Only after limits: the effective limits

noindex.description: Ask search engines not to index the site (X-Robots-Tag on every response)

protected.description: false removes password protection; true without password requires an existing one

password.description: Visitor password; protects the site or changes its password. Never returned

expires_at.description: When the site is taken down and soft-deleted; null removes the expiry. Future, at most 10 years ahead

hostname.description: Domain name; Unicode names are stored in punycode

visitors.description: Approximate unique visitors of the day

name.description: Page path or referrer host; "" is a direct visit, "*" everything beyond the stored rows

days.description: Every day of the period, oldest first

LimitOverrides.description: Personal limits; null or a missing field inherits the global value. A PATCH replaces all overrides

upstream_url.description: https base address; with auth path it contains {secret}

allowed_hosts.description: Exact https hosts the request and its redirects may reach; the upstream host comes first

paths.description: Allowed path prefixes; empty allows every path

auth_name.description: Header or query parameter name (header and query)

secret_set.description: Whether a key is stored; the key itself is never returned

secret_url.description: Web interface screen where the user pastes the key

call_url.description: Address a page of the site calls, followed by the upstream path

errors.description: Forwarded calls that failed (upstream 5xx or unreachable)

rejected.description: Calls refused before forwarding (method, path, origin, rate, missing key, size)

last_status.description: HTTP status of the last call

upstream_url.description: https://host/base; no key in the query

allowed_hosts.description: Extra exact hosts for redirects (the upstream host is always included); at most 10

methods.description: Subset of GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE; default GET and POST

paths.description: Up to 10 path prefixes starting with /; default: every path

auth_name.description: Header name (auth header) or query parameter (auth query)

target.description: Telegram chat ID (empty while a link binding is pending), e-mail address or webhook URL

consecutive_failures.description: Failed delivery attempts in a row

paused_at.description: Set when deliveries to a webhook were paused after repeated failures; resume with PATCH {"enabled": true}

secret.description: Webhook signing secret, returned only on creation and rotation

link.description: t.me link that binds a Telegram chat (telegram without target)

cabinet_url.description: Web interface page with the submissions and channels of the site

altcha_max_number.description: Base proof-of-work difficulty; repeated challenges from one IP get 4x harder each (up to 256x)

secrets_unreadable.description: A stored secret cannot be decrypted (restored without state/secrets.key)

telegram_token.description: Checked with Telegram getMe; empty string removes it

server_ips.description: A/AAAA targets for a root domain; empty when unknown

global.description: Counters an administrator adds to every site (read-only)

new_deploy_id.description: Release created to apply changed counters to a published site

UpdateCountersRequest.description: Pass at least one field; absent fields are kept

detail.description: For apps: the host the app returned to when connecting

current.description: True for the token this request was authenticated with

site.description: ID or slug of any user's site

confirm.description: The same ID or slug again, after the user confirmed

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page

deploy_id.description: The release read; pass it as base_deploy_id

encoding.description: Empty when the content is not included

note.description: Why the content is not included

paths.description: Paths or patterns such as css/*.css

site.description: Empty: a new site on commit
